rules: Human review of a small diagnostic set, not a calibrated accuracy benchmark.
Precision: useful, contextually defensible eligible highlights divided by all eligible highlights. Suppressed candidates do not count as highlights.
Recall: distinct required learning items covered divided by all required items. Generation failures count as misses, with validity reported separately.
One candidate covers at most one primary learning item. Whole-sentence overlap alone does not earn coverage of every expression it contains; the assessment must address the learning item.
Correct ambiguity analysis is an acceptable optional highlight, excluded from recall denominator. A definite unsupported telescope reading is a false positive.

Additional highlights may be accepted only if a concrete equivalent or independently useful nuance is documented in the human review. Basic literal actions are not useful for this fluent-reader profile.
Overbroad spans are recorded separately from semantic correctness; do not silently reward vague summaries.
Explanation judgments: sound, partial, or incorrect based on core meaning, unsupported assertions, uncertainty and relevance. Valid JSON is not proof of correctness.
